title: PAR-02 AC5: EXECUTION_PARTITION_CREATED event not emitted — needs a platform-event append design (no instance_id convention exists)
summary: PAR-02 AC5 (each partition creation appends EXECUTION_PARTITION_CREATED carrying partition name + range bounds) is unimplemented. src/scheduler/partition_maintenance.zig::ensurePartitionAttached() creates and attaches partitions but never calls Store.append() or emits any event. Investigated fixing directly during REWORK 1: Store.append() requires instance_id to exist as an ACTIVE row in instance_projections (StoreError.InstanceNotFound otherwise); partition_maintenance.zig is a platform-level daily job with no owning workflow instance, and no system/platform instance_id convention exists anywhere in this codebase. Every other platform-level EXECUTION_* event of the same shape named in docs/requirements.yaml (EXECUTION_MIGRATION_VALIDATED, EXECUTION_OUTBOX_GATE_OPENED, EXECUTION_CORRELATION_LAG, EXECUTION_INGRESS_REFUSED, EXECUTION_PARTITION_DETACHED, EXECUTION_PARTITION_DROPPED) is also unimplemented, confirming no precedent exists to copy. Needs a CODE-DESIGNER design note establishing the platform-event append convention before BACKEND-DEV can implement — not a quick fix. Sub-finding of GH #223 (PAR-02 parent requirement tracking issue).

details.summary: No design artefact in this codebase specifies how a non-instance-scoped platform/system event (instance_id has no owning workflow instance) should be appended through Store.append(), which hard-requires an ACTIVE instance_projections row. This blocks EXECUTION_PARTITION_CREATED (PAR-02 AC5) and at least five other EXECUTION_* platform events named in docs/requirements.yaml.

emit_site.description: The event must be emitted after the successful 'INSERT INTO plat_partition_catalog … ON CONFLICT … DO UPDATE' exec (line 316–326) and immediately before 'return true;' at line 328. At that point the partition name (partition_name), parent table, range_start, and range_end are all in scope and the attach has been confirmed. No call to Store.append() or any other event sink exists here today.

store_append_instance_id_check.check_sql: SELECT status FROM instance_projections WHERE instance_id = $1
store_append_instance_id_check.description: Store.append() Step 1 (lines 370–382) issues a SELECT against instance_projections for params.instance_id before any write. If the row is absent (rows.len == 0) the function returns StoreError.InstanceNotFound and rolls back. It additionally rejects CANCELLED/COMPLETED status. partition_maintenance.zig is a platform-level daily job with no owning workflow instance, so no row in instance_projections will ever exist for it, making this check a hard blocker.

platform_event_convention_required.description: A CODE-DESIGNER design note must specify: (1) whether platform events use a fixed synthetic instance_id (e.g. a well-known UUIDv5 derived from 'platform') permanently seeded as ACTIVE in instance_projections, or whether Store.append() needs a new InstanceNotFound carve-out/bypass path for platform events; (2) the actor_id convention for scheduler-driven events (no human actor); (3) the idempotency_key shape (e.g. deterministic hash of partition_name + event_type); (4) the tenant_id value (NULL or a reserved platform tenant UUID). Without this, the call site at line 328 cannot be implemented correctly.

resolution.summary: PAR-02 AC5 implemented via Store.appendPlatform() in src/event_store/store.zig (bypasses instance_projections lookup for non-instance-scoped platform events). Added src/event_store/platform.zig with PLATFORM_INSTANCE_ID/ACTOR_ID/TENANT_ID sentinel constants. ensurePartitionAttached() in src/scheduler/partition_maintenance.zig now emits EXECUTION_PARTITION_CREATED (non-fatal on emit failure). Migration 1152 seeds EXECUTION_PARTITION_CREATED/DETACHED/DROPPED in event_type_registry. This convention unblocks 5 other EXECUTION_* platform events. NOTE: TC-PAR-02-09 Zig integration test code (asserting the event is present in the events table) is a follow-up task — the test spec was written by TEST-DESIGNER in step-05 but the Zig assertion code was not added to the test binary in this run.

verification.method: Code review of Store.appendPlatform(), platform.zig constants, ensurePartitionAttached() emit site, and migration 1152 seed entries. TC-PAR-02-09 Zig assertion code is a follow-up task.

prevention: CODE-DESIGNER should produce a short design note establishing the platform-event append convention (instance_id/actor_id/idempotency_key shape for non-instance-scoped events, and whether Store.append() needs an InstanceNotFound carve-out or platform events need a dedicated lower-level insert path) before any of the six affected EXECUTION_* events are implemented.
